title: com.pqt.store.zone.entered data

how.description: How the track came into the zone (N4): crossed its boundary, or appeared inside it (first seen there: a person found again after an occlusion, or a tracker identity change). Absent means crossed.

description: 1.1.0 adds the optional `how` (Tier 2 N4), so rules can tell a real entry or exit from a tracking break. Everything 1.0.0 accepts is still accepted.
